text: See what the IHS Markit Score report has to say about Apple Inc. IHS Markit 4 days at current score. Upgraded from Neutral on March 9th 2018 View full report here! Summary This company ranked positively in 3 out of 4 IHS Markit Categories and also compared to the Technology sector Perception of the company's creditworthiness is positive Bearish sentiment is low Economic output in this company's sector is expanding Bearish sentiment Short interest | Positive Short interest is extremely low for AAPL with fewer than 1% of shares on loan. This could indicate that investors who seek to profit from falling equity prices are not currently targeting AAPL. Money flow ETF/Index ownership | Neutral ETF activity is neutral. ETFs that hold AAPL had net inflows of $1.33 billion over the last one-month. Economic sentiment PMI by IHS Markit | Positive Story Continues According to the latest IHS Markit Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) data, output in the Technology sector is rising. The rate of growth is strong relative to the trend shown over the past year. Credit worthiness Credit default swap | Positive The current level displays a positive indicator. AAPL credit default swap spreads are near the lowest level of the last three years and indicate the market's continued positive perception of the company's credit worthiness.
